title: From scheduler halt to verifier start
statement: Let $S$ and $V$ be deterministic machines over bits, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $S$ on input $x$ whose state is halted. Let $u$ and $w$ be finite bit strings with $|w|=|x	ext{ followed by }u|+2$. Running the combined host machine on choice string $w$ from the guessing-phase configuration formed from $c$ and $u$ yields the verifier-phase configuration whose verifier component is the initial configuration of $V$ on input $x$ followed by $u$, whose boundary tag is true, and whose remaining tape and head data are those specified by $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $S,V$ are finite deterministic machines over bits
$c$ is a configuration of $S$ on input $x$
replaced: Let $S, V$ be deterministic machines, $d$ a halted scheduler configuration on an input $x$, $u$ a guessed word, and $w$ any choice word with $|w| = |x\,u| + 2$. Running the host under $w$ from the guessing-phase configuration for $(d,u)$ installs the verifier-phase configuration for the initial configuration of $V$ on the assembled word $x\,u$.
